title: Identification of Biomarkers for Oxidative Stress in Age-Related Macular Degeneration: Combining Transcriptomics and Mendelian Randomization Analysis.
reason: The paper does not present single-cell omics data; it reanalyzes bulk gene expression datasets (GSE29801, GSE135092) and validates with qRT-PCR. No multi-sample single-cell integration, no batch correction, and no code provided. Not suitable for single-cell data integration benchmarking.
methods_summary: The study identified oxidative stress-related biomarkers for AMD by combining differential expression analysis on GEO datasets (GSE29801, GSE135092), machine learning feature selection, functional enrichment, immune cell infiltration analysis, Mendelian randomization, and qRT-PCR validation in a simulated AMD cell model.
